prompt: Market shows p_market=0.50, all three sources agree on p_yes=0.52, w_market=0.3, best_ask=0.51. What does signals.json look like and is this a trade?
expected_output: p_blend = 0.3*0.50 + 0.7*(0.52+0.52+0.52)/3 = 0.514. edge = 0.014 < 0.05, so trade=false with reason 'edge below threshold (0.014 < 0.05)'.

assertions.name: computes_blend_correctly
assertions.description: Output must show the blend computation

assertions.name: sets_reason_field
assertions.description: Output must include the reason field in the output
assertions.check: output contains 'reason' AND ('edge below' or 'edge>0.05' or 'no signal')

assertions.name: trade_false
assertions.description: Output must explicitly say trade=false for this case
